_comment: Claude Code project settings (.claude/settings.json). On every session start: install particulars if it is missing (checksum-verified, no prompts), then install the agent skill into .claude/skills/. Commit a .dkf pointer at the repo root if the workspace lives in a subdirectory. Remote sessions need outbound access to github.com.

hooks.command: command -v particulars >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodelogicau/particulars-cli/main/install.sh | sh; particulars skill install --json >/dev/null
